name: Media shelf
summary: Two swipeable rows for a streaming home: Continue watching, with stills, a progress bar and the time left, and Because you watched, with posters and New season labels.
use: on the home screen of a video, music or course app, for picking up where people left off
a11y: Each row is a labelled list that scrolls inside itself (swipe, shift-scroll or the arrow buttons, which turn off at each end); every title is one button whose name says the episode and time left.

use_when: a browse page that groups titles into rows by theme, with posters to pick from
avoid_when: one title's own page with its seasons and episodes: use title-detail
a list of episodes to play in order: use podcast-episodes or track-list
a row of short stories that open full screen: use story-rail

parts.name: heading
parts.what: the row's name; a muted lead-in can sit before it

parts.name: nav
parts.what: back and forward arrows, shown on wide screens, off at each end

parts.name: items
parts.what: one title: a still or poster, its name and a line under it

parts.name: progress
parts.what: how much has been watched, on stills only

parts.name: sub
parts.what: episode and time left, the kind of title, or a New label in the accent colour

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a row fails to load, keep its heading and show one alert-banners line with a retry in place of the tiles

disabled.how: the back arrow is off at the start of a row and the forward arrow at the end

overflow.how: each row scrolls sideways in its own box with snapping; wider boxes show more tiles and the arrows
overflow.evidence: overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory

long_text.how: a long title or line under it ends in an ellipsis
long_text.evidence: .odl-name { overflow: hidden; font: var(--ds-text-label-lg); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the arrows (wide screens only), the row itself, then each title in it
with a row focused, the arrow keys scroll it, as the browser does for any scroll box
Enter or Space on an arrow scrolls the row by about one screen
Enter or Space on a title presses it; the file has no action for it
